body: From the DM-176 review (orchestrator, this run): run-scope overhead (DM-173 records orchestration/reviewer threads in run buckets) never reaches a ticket score because only tickets have baselines; decide how run/sprint roll-ups show it. E is only as good as self-classification (a twice-rejected ticket labeled all productive scores E 100); do not assume retries bound E. `getRunEfficiency` re-projects every run per call: freeze the efficiency inputs into report snapshots rather than recompute.
